summary: Ansible 12 community.general removals: ansible-core 2.15 support dropped (needs 2.16+, Python 3.10+ on the controller), Proxmox content moved to community.proxmox (install it explicitly), apt_rpm present/installed now mean present_not_latest, clc_* modules removed, django_manage ack_venv_creation_deprecation removed, and git_config can no longer read values with state=present (use git_config_info).
questions: Where did the community.general proxmox modules go?
How do I read a git config value now that git_config can't?
Which ansible-core version does community.general need in Ansible 12?
Does apt_rpm state=present still upgrade packages?

answer_card.title: Proxmox modules moved to community.proxmox
answer_card.answer_md:
The Proxmox modules and plugins left community.general; since 11.0.0 the old names are deprecated redirects. Install the new collection explicitly and switch to its FQCNs:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install community.proxmox
```

Then use `community.proxmox.<module>` in roles and playbooks to avoid deprecation messages.
